title: sabba sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
At Sāvatthī. “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the all.
Listen to that. And what, bhikkhus, is the all?

The eye and visual forms, the ear and sounds,
the nose and odors, the tongue and tastes,
the body and sensations, the mind and mental objects.
This is called the all.

If anyone, bhikkhus, should speak thus:
‘Having rejected this all, I shall make known another all.’

This would be just a baseless statement on his part,
and if questioned, he would not be able to reply.
And further, he would meet with frustration. For what reason? Because, bhikkhus, that is outside his range.”
